_comment: Koeboard-only models, merged into the upstream catalog.json at load (Rust: catalog/mod.rs, frontend: src/lib/models/koeboardCatalog.ts). Same shape as catalog.json's models[] and results{}. Kept separate so catalog.json stays a verbatim copy of @handy-computer/models.

models.name: Parakeet TDT-CTC 0.6B Japanese
models.description: Japanese only. Fast, with good accuracy; converted from nvidia/parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja.

_results_note: ja: FLEURS test, 650 utterances, Q8_0, transcribe.cpp scripts/wer (run.py + score.py, CER), measured 2026-11-02 on Apple M4 Metal; same pipeline reproduces SenseVoiceSmall's published 7.63% as 7.62%. performance: not measured on the benchmark machine; copied from parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (same 0.6B FastConformer encoder; encode time on M4 within 5%).
